say:0:1520425001:0.source_cn: 把针蝗肉交给托洛，顺便问问营地的情况……
say:0:1520425001:0.male: I'll bring the meat to Tolo and ask about the camp.
say:0:1520425001:0.female: I'll bring the meat to Tolo and ask about the camp.

say:1:1520426001:0.text: Where did that rotten meat come from?
say:1:1520426001:0.source_cn: 那些腐烂的肉，是从哪里来的？

say:2:1520426002:0.text: Uh... it was from old hunts.
say:2:1520426002:0.source_cn: 肉？呃……是之前打猎打到的。

say:3:1520426003:0.text: There used to be plenty of animals—mongrels, wild sheep... all sorts.
say:3:1520426003:0.source_cn: 以前这附近有很多动物，土狗、野羊……各种各样，什么都有。

say:4:1520426004:1.text: But since the famine, they've grown fewer and weaker... and now, we haven't seen one in a long time.
say:4:1520426004:1.source_cn: 不过自从饥荒开始，这里的动物也越来越少，越来越瘦……到...

say:5:1520426005:0.text: All that rotten meat was from <style="highlight">Zeffi's</style> hunts ages ago. That's why it spoiled like this...
say:5:1520426005:0.source_cn: 这些腐烂的肉，都是好久之前<style=highlig...

choice_prompt:6:1520426005.text: All that rotten meat was from <style="highlight">Zeffi's</style> hunts ages ago. That's why it spoiled like this...
choice_prompt:6:1520426005.source_cn: 这些腐烂的肉，都是好久之前<style=highlight>泽菲罗大哥</style>打到带回营地的，所以才会坏成这样……

say:7:1520426006:0.text: Mhm, he's five years older than me. I guess that counts?
say:7:1520426006:0.source_cn: 嗯，他比我大五岁，应该算是大人吧？
say:7:1520426006:0.male: Mhm, he's five years older than me. I guess that counts?
say:7:1520426006:0.female: Mhm, he's five years older than me. I guess that counts?

say:8:1520426007:0.text: But... he's not in camp now...
say:8:1520426007:0.source_cn: 不过他……他现在不在营地……
say:8:1520426007:0.male: But... he's not in camp now...
say:8:1520426007:0.female: But... he's not in camp now...

say:11:1520426010:0.text: No need to panic. We just want to know where everyone went.
say:11:1520426010:0.source_cn: 不必紧张，我们只是想知道大家都去了哪里。

say:12:1520426011:0.text: Look around—this camp is all children. Even with a reliable boy like you, they still need adult supervision, don't they?
say:12:1520426011:0.source_cn: 你看，营地里有这么多孩子。即便有可靠的你在，但依然不能...

narration:16:1520426014:0.text: Tolo suddenly spins and runs off.
narration:16:1520426014:0.source_cn: 托洛猛地转过身去，径直跑走了

say:17:1520426015:1.text: Why is he running? We didn't hurt him.
say:17:1520426015:1.source_cn: 他为什么要跑？我们没有对他做什么。

say:19:1520426016:1.text: Told you, don't pry if you don't want ugly answers.
say:19:1520426016:1.source_cn: 早就和你们说过，没必要打听这些。

choice_prompt:21:1520426017.source_cn: 算了，<style=highlight>我去看看</style>。你们别跟过来。

say:22:1520426018:1.text: What, you expected a search party?
say:22:1520426018:1.male: What, you expected a search party?
say:22:1520426018:1.female: What, you expected a search party?

say:23:1520426021:0.text: Merlin, babysit the newbies and don't let them follow me. I work better alone.
say:23:1520426021:0.source_cn: 梅林，看好他们，别跟上来。

narration:25:1520426022:0.text: Morgan leaves with a grim expression.

say:26:1520426023:0.text: ... We're really letting him go alone?

say:28:1520426025:0.text: When ordinary people are trapped in hardship, Morgan never stands idle. I've seen it myself.
say:28:1520426025:0.source_cn: 请相信我，当普通人囿于困顿之境，摩根绝不会袖手旁观，这...

say:29:1520426026:1.text: Until he and Tolo return, help me <style="highlight">distribute the cooked meat</style>. These children have suffered long enough, they need some relief.
say:29:1520426026:1.source_cn: 在他和托洛返回之前，就请陪我<style=highli...

say:31:1520426019:1.text: Comfort? Please. I plan to annoy him into talking.
say:31:1520426019:1.male: Comfort? Please. I plan to annoy him into talking.
say:31:1520426019:1.female: Comfort? Please. I plan to annoy him into talking.

choice:21:1:2.text: You know how to comfort kids?
choice:21:1:2.male: You know how to comfort kids?
choice:21:1:2.female: You know how to comfort kids?

say:32:1520426020:1.text: Crying takes effort—I'm going for minimal effort.
say:32:1520426020:1.male: Crying takes effort—I'm going for minimal effort.
say:32:1520426020:1.female: Crying takes effort—I'm going for minimal effort.

say:0:1520427001:0.text: You and your companions begin handing out food.
say:0:1520427001:0.source_cn: 请陪我一同将烹饪后的肉分发给饥民吧。
say:0:1520427001:0.male: You and your companions begin handing out food.
say:0:1520427001:0.female: You and your companions begin handing out food.

say:1:1520430001:0.text: Thank you all for bringing us meat!
say:1:1520430001:0.source_cn: 谢谢，谢谢你们带来的肉！

say:2:1520430002:0.text: I don't even know what kind it is, but it's so delicious... I haven't had meat in so long!
say:2:1520430002:0.source_cn: 虽然不知道是什么肉，但是好好吃……我已经很久没吃到肉了！

say:3:1520430003:0.text: If only Mom and Dad could taste this too...
say:3:1520430003:0.source_cn: 要是爸爸妈妈也能吃到就好了……<key:dialog1>

choice_prompt:4:1520430003.text: If only Mom and Dad could taste this too...
choice_prompt:4:1520430003.source_cn: 要是爸爸妈妈也能吃到就好了……

say:6:1520430006:0.text: The grown-ups said there's no prey left nearby, so they had to go farther to hunt.
say:6:1520430006:0.source_cn: 大人们都说，周围的猎物太少了，所以要去更远一点的地方捕猎。

say:7:1520430007:0.text: They've been gone for a while, though... I've lost track of the days. But I'm sure they'll come back soon!
say:7:1520430007:0.source_cn: 不过，他们已经出门好久了……我记不清有多少天了。但应该...

say:9:1520430008:0.text: None of the hunting parties have returned?
say:9:1520430008:0.source_cn: 外出捕猎的人没有回来……？

say:10:1520430009:0.text: You catch Gala's concern. The hunters are likely gone for good—but none of you want to crush the children's hopes with the truth.
say:10:1520430009:0.source_cn: 你听懂了加拉的言外之意，离开营地的大人恐怕再也回不来了...
say:10:1520430009:0.male: You catch Gala's concern. The hunters are likely gone for good—but none of you want to crush the children's hopes with the truth.
say:10:1520430009:0.female: You catch Gala's concern. The hunters are likely gone for good—but none of you want to crush the children's hopes with the truth.

say:11:1520430010:0.text: Such faith in the world... If the gods can't protect them, it's no fault of their own.
say:11:1520430010:0.source_cn: 多么乐观的孩子啊……诸神未能保佑你们，是他们的过错。

say:12:1520430011:0.text: So tell me, while your parents are away, who brings you food?
say:12:1520430011:0.source_cn: 那么，大人外出时，你们的食物从何而来？

say:14:1520430013:0.text: Ahino and the others are weak, but when they're feeling okay, they help Tolo catch small animals. He even cooks for us.
say:14:1520430013:0.source_cn: 阿赫诺哥哥他们身体不好，但他们不那么难受的时候，托洛哥...

say:15:1520430014:0.text: By the way, where is Tolo? He works so hard, he deserves an extra share of meat!
say:15:1520430014:0.source_cn: 说起来，托洛哥哥去哪里了？他那么辛苦，得多吃一份肉才行。

say:17:1520430005:0.text: I know what you're thinking, but they're not dead! They just... went further out.
say:17:1520430005:0.source_cn: 我知道你在想什么，但是我爸爸妈妈才没有死！他们只是出去...
say:17:1520430005:0.male: I know what you're thinking, but they're not dead! They just... went further out.
say:17:1520430005:0.female: I know what you're thinking, but they're not dead! They just... went further out.

narration:0:1520431001:0.text: As the last of the locust meat is handed out, there's still no sign of Morgan and Tolo.
narration:0:1520431001:0.source_cn: 将蝗虫肉分发给饥民后，摩根和托洛依然没有回来
narration:0:1520431001:0.male: As the last of the locust meat is handed out, there's still no sign of Morgan and Tolo.
narration:0:1520431001:0.female: As the last of the locust meat is handed out, there's still no sign of Morgan and Tolo.

narration:1:1520431002:0.text: During the lull, you reflect on everything you've just learned...
narration:1:1520431002:0.source_cn: 趁着休息的时间，你们谈起了刚刚打听到的消息……
narration:1:1520431002:0.male: During the lull, you reflect on everything you've just learned...
narration:1:1520431002:0.female: During the lull, you reflect on everything you've just learned...

say:3:1520431003:1.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, those Halian hunters... they're probably not coming back, right?
say:3:1520431003:1.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, those Halian hunters... they're probably not coming back, right?
say:3:1520431003:1.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, those Halian hunters... they're probably not coming back, right?

say:4:1520431004:0.text: Do you think they died hunting beasts?
say:4:1520431004:0.source_cn: 他们和野兽搏斗，然后死了吗？
say:4:1520431004:0.male: Do you think they died hunting beasts?
say:4:1520431004:0.female: Do you think they died hunting beasts?

choice_prompt:5:1520431003.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, those Halian hunters... they're probably not coming back, right?
choice_prompt:5:1520431003.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>大人，外出打猎的呼临人应该不会再回来了。
choice_prompt:5:1520431003.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, those Halian hunters... they're probably not coming back, right?
choice_prompt:5:1520431003.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, those Halian hunters... they're probably not coming back, right?

say:6:1520431005:0.text: Your obsession with the truth surprises me.
say:6:1520431005:0.source_cn: 你对真相的执着令我惊讶。
say:6:1520431005:0.male: Your obsession with the truth surprises me.
say:6:1520431005:0.female: Your obsession with the truth surprises me.

say:7:1520431006:0.text: If you want answers, I suspect Tolo has them.
say:7:1520431006:0.source_cn: 我想，托洛或许可以为你解答疑问……
say:7:1520431006:0.male: If you want answers, I suspect Tolo has them.
say:7:1520431006:0.female: If you want answers, I suspect Tolo has them.

say:8:1520431007:0.text: But Morgan said not to follow him.
say:8:1520431007:0.source_cn: 但是，摩根刚刚不许我们跟过去。

say:9:1520431008:0.text: And you usually listen to Morgan? Interesting. In times like this, breaking a rule or two in pursuit of the truth does no harm.
say:9:1520431008:0.source_cn: 在某些时候，为了真相违背一些法则也无伤大雅。

say:10:1520431009:0.text: Besides, neither of them has returned. Perhaps they've run into unexpected trouble—even the kind Morgan can't solve.
say:10:1520431009:0.source_cn: 何况摩根和托洛至今尚未归来，或许是面临了一些意料之外的...

choice_prompt:11:1520431009.text: Besides, neither of them has returned. Perhaps they've run into unexpected trouble—even the kind Morgan can't solve.
choice_prompt:11:1520431009.source_cn: 何况摩根和托洛至今尚未归来，或许是面临了一些意料之外的问题。连摩根也无法解决的问题。

say:12:1520431011:0.text: Morgan's methods are unorthodox, but he's no villain.
say:12:1520431011:0.source_cn: 摩根做事剑走偏锋，但他绝非恶徒。
say:12:1520431011:0.male: Morgan's methods are unorthodox, but he's no villain.
say:12:1520431011:0.female: Morgan's methods are unorthodox, but he's no villain.

say:13:1520431012:1.text: Come. Let's <style="highlight">find Morgan and Tolo</style> and uncover the truth that's piqued your curiosity.
say:13:1520431012:1.male: Come. Let's <style="highlight">find Morgan and Tolo</style> and uncover the truth that's piqued your curiosity.
say:13:1520431012:1.female: Come. Let's <style="highlight">find Morgan and Tolo</style> and uncover the truth that's piqued your curiosity.

choice:11:0:1.text: What, like Morgan making the kid cry?
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 比如说，摩根把托洛吓哭了？
choice:11:0:1.male: What, like Morgan making the kid cry?
choice:11:0:1.female: What, like Morgan making the kid cry?

say:15:1520431010:0.text: Of course I do. He's the Second Seat of the Arcane Council. My ally. And let's be honest—if Morgan's sticking around me, it's not just loyalty. It's trust.
say:15:1520431010:0.source_cn: 他是魔法师协会的一员，是与我共同经历了许多的第二席。他...
say:15:1520431010:0.male: Of course I do. He's the Second Seat of the Arcane Council. My ally. And let's be honest—if Morgan's sticking around me, it's not just loyalty. It's trust.
say:15:1520431010:0.female: Of course I do. He's the Second Seat of the Arcane Council. My ally. And let's be honest—if Morgan's sticking around me, it's not just loyalty. It's trust.

choice:11:1:2.text: You really trust him a lot.
choice:11:1:2.male: You really trust him a lot.
choice:11:1:2.female: You really trust him a lot.

choice:5:0:1.text: They were probably weak and malnourished.
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 饥荒之下，呼临人没那么健壮
choice:5:0:1.male: They were probably weak and malnourished.
choice:5:0:1.female: They were probably weak and malnourished.

choice:5:1:2.text: Maybe they didn't want their kids to see them die.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 他们可能不想让孩子面对自己的死……
choice:5:1:2.male: Maybe they didn't want their kids to see them die.
choice:5:1:2.female: Maybe they didn't want their kids to see them die.

choice:5:2:3.text: Maybe it was just bad luck.
choice:5:2:3.male: Maybe it was just bad luck.
choice:5:2:3.female: Maybe it was just bad luck.

say:0:1520432001:0.source_cn: 登上山崖，他们就在高处。

say:0:1520434001:0.text: Morgan and Tolo are there. And those markers... are they graves?
say:0:1520434001:0.source_cn: 摩根和托洛在前面。但那些石碑……是呼临人的坟墓？

say:5:1520435003:0.text: ... I haven't said a word yet.
say:5:1520435003:0.male: ... I haven't said a word yet.
say:5:1520435003:0.female: ... I haven't said a word yet.

say:6:1520435004:0.text: I get the rookie tagging along, but Merlin? You too?
say:6:1520435004:0.source_cn: 新人追过来也就算了。梅林，怎么连你也跟他们一起？
say:6:1520435004:0.male: I get the rookie tagging along, but Merlin? You too?
say:6:1520435004:0.female: I get the rookie tagging along, but Merlin? You too?

say:8:1520435005:0.text: Could I say no when <style="stress"><player_name></style> asks so nicely?
say:8:1520435005:0.male: Could I say no when <style="stress"><player_name></style> asks so nicely?
say:8:1520435005:0.female: Could I say no when <style="stress"><player_name></style> asks so nicely?

say:9:1520435006:0.text: Tolo? What's wrong? Why are you crying?

say:13:1520435008:0.text: Ugh. Fine. I'll spell it out.

say:14:1520435009:0.text: When the famine started, a few Halians discovered wild sheep out here. They thought it might be enough to get through the worst of it, so they set up a small camp. Tolo's family was part of that group.
say:14:1520435009:0.source_cn: 饥荒刚开始的时候，有一群呼临人发现这附近有不少野羊，想...

say:15:1520435010:0.text: But then word got out. More people came, hoping for the same chance—but the land couldn't support everyone. So the adults started giving up their share of food to keep the children alive.
say:15:1520435010:0.source_cn: 之后，听说这件事的人越来越多，都赶来投奔他们。食物不够了。

say:16:1520435011:0.text: And when they couldn't hold out any longer... they left the camp, one by one. Said they were going hunting. But really—they came here to die.
say:16:1520435011:0.source_cn: 为了把活命的机会留给孩子，那些大人几乎什么都不吃。撑不...

choice_prompt:17:1520435011.text: And when they couldn't hold out any longer... they left the camp, one by one. Said they were going hunting. But really—they came here to die.
choice_prompt:17:1520435011.source_cn: 为了把活命的机会留给孩子，那些大人几乎什么都不吃。撑不下去了就借口外出打猎，来这里等死。

say:19:1520435012:0.text: They gave me all the food... and I never knew...
say:19:1520435012:0.source_cn: 他们……他们也是……因为要把食物留给我……

say:20:1520435013:0.text: I don't want this. I don't want to be the only one left...
say:20:1520435013:0.source_cn: 可是，可是我不想这样，不想一个人……

say:22:1520435015:0.text: Whenever someone died, the others buried them here and raised a stone marker.
say:22:1520435015:0.source_cn: 死者咽气以后，剩下还活着的人就会带他们来这里，埋葬他们...

say:23:1520435016:0.text: The last adult who knew the full story brought him here, explained everything... and then left for the last time.
say:23:1520435016:0.source_cn: 他父母离开时，他还不知道真相。是最后一个知情的大人，在...

say:24:1520435017:0.text: But why would they do that?

say:25:1520435018:0.text: Maybe to keep the plan alive. Or maybe... they were afraid no one would lay them to rest. Afraid these graves would vanish from memory. Who's to say?
say:25:1520435018:0.source_cn: 或许是要让这个计划继续进行下去，又或许是怕没人帮自己埋...

say:27:1520435019:1.text: Tolo... no child should have to carry something this heavy.
say:27:1520435019:1.source_cn: ……托洛……这些沉重的真相不该由你来背负。

choice_prompt:28:1520435019.text: Tolo... no child should have to carry something this heavy.
choice_prompt:28:1520435019.source_cn: ……托洛……这些沉重的真相不该由你来背负。

say:29:1520435020:0.text: Really...? All we do is lie, and steal food, and scramble to survive. I don't even know what we're surviving for...
say:29:1520435020:0.source_cn: 是吗？我们拼命地找吃的、说谎话，就只是想再多活一天。可...

say:30:1520435021:0.text: I wonder what they were thinking back then... in their final moments.
say:30:1520435021:0.source_cn: ……我不知道，爸爸妈妈……最后会在想什么呢？

choice:28:1:2.text: Your parents would be proud of you.
choice:28:1:2.male: Your parents would be proud of you.
choice:28:1:2.female: Your parents would be proud of you.

say:31:1520435022:0.text: Tolo, want to hear some tragic things I've been through?
say:31:1520435022:0.source_cn: 托洛，要听点我经历过的悲惨事件吗？

choice_prompt:32:1520435022.text: Tolo, want to hear some tragic things I've been through?
choice_prompt:32:1520435022.source_cn: 托洛，要听点我经历过的悲惨事件吗？

say:33:1520435023:0.text: I've seen some things, things that make everything else feel a little less unbearable. Just speaking from experience.
say:33:1520435023:0.source_cn: 知道有人和你一样惨之后，心里会好受一些。经验。

say:34:1520435024:0.text: You've... been through stuff like this too?
say:34:1520435024:0.source_cn: 你……你也经历过类似的事情吗？

say:36:1520435026:1.text: A town swallowed whole by an earthquake. You walk the ruins, hear faint cries under rubble. Every day they fade, and you can't help anyone.
say:36:1520435026:1.source_cn: 被一场地震吞没的城镇，走在废墟上，能听到不知道从何处传...

say:37:1520435027:1.text: A village wiped out by plague. The dying exiled beyond the walls. Even a burial beside loved ones became... a privilege.
say:37:1520435027:1.source_cn: 一座被瘟疫席卷的村子，患病的人不得不离开，连与自己的亲...

say:38:1520435028:1.text: A priest struck down by divine wrath—for reasons unknown. His entire village paid the price. Innocents, all of them.
say:38:1520435028:1.source_cn: 不知道做错了什么而引来神怒的祭司，导致整个村庄覆灭，无...

say:39:1520435029:1.text: The worst part? Many disasters fall by the gods' whim, unnoticed by mortals.
say:39:1520435029:1.source_cn: 最可怕的是，许多灾难是诸神不经意间降下的，但凡人却对此...

say:40:1520435030:0.text: You've done better than many, Tolo. At least you've held on to your humanity.
say:40:1520435030:0.source_cn: 你们做得比许多人好，至少你们守住了身为人的底线。

say:41:1520435031:0.source_cn: 你说的那些，是真的吗？是你亲眼见到的……？

say:42:1520435032:0.text: How are you still... How can anyone witness so much and keep going?
say:42:1520435032:0.source_cn: 你怎么会……见过那么多惨剧……

say:43:1520435033:1.text: ... Good question. I'd love an answer myself.
